description:
The process begins when a company identifies the need for a new supplier or vendor.
The procurement team issues a request for proposals (RFP) and receives responses from various suppliers.
Each proposal is evaluated based on criteria like cost, quality, and delivery time.
The team may also conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers.
After careful analysis, a supplier is selected, and contract negotiations begin.
Once both parties agree on the terms, the contract is signed.
The process ends when the supplier is officially onboarded, and the contract is executed.

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CompletionSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AssessmentMerge" name="Merge assessment paths"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AgreeTerms" name="Reach agreement on contract terms"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompletionSplit" name="Complete onboarding and contract execution"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Officially onboard supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExecuteContract" name="Execute contract"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompletionJoin" name="Join completion"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Identify" sourceRef="Start_SupplierNeed" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evaluate_Decision" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentDecision" targetRef="Task_ConductAssessment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">site visits or interviews are conducted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentDecision" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assessment_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ConductAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Analyze" sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge" targetRef="Task_AnalyzeAndSelect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Analyze_Negotiate" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzeAndSelect" targetRef="Task_NegotiateTerms"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Onboard_Join" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Execute_Join" sourceRef="Task_ExecuteContract" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin" targetRef="End_Complete"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RFP" name="Request for proposals" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Participant_Suppliers" messageRef="Message_RFP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Proposal" name="Supplier proposals" sourceRef="Participant_Suppliers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal"/>
